skills.description:
Search the user's local work memory (Office Memory / OMem) — a unified,
locally-indexed wiki built from the user's emails, calendar events,
documents, and collaboration notes. OMem ingests from whatever sources
the user has configured: mail kind (e.g. macOS Mail.app, Outlook
Classic, Outlook on the Web, AppleScript-driven mailboxes), calendar
kind (Calendar.app, Outlook calendars, .ics files), file kind (any
local folder — OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, ~/Documents, plain
directories), and loop kind (Microsoft Teams Loop notes). Future
versions add Slack / Jira / Notion. The wiki abstracts over all of
these — you don't need to know which source a hit came from.

USE THIS SKILL whenever the user's question touches their work
context, even implicitly — past meetings, colleagues' names, project
codenames, vendor/contract details, "that document I saw last week",
"what did X say about Y", upcoming/past calendar items, internal
acronyms, RFPs, performance reviews, OKRs, anything that sounds like
it could live in their work history (any inbox, calendar, local
folder, or collaboration tool they use for work). When in doubt,
CALL omem query FIRST and decide afterward whether the results help.

DO NOT use this skill for: weather, general programming questions,
translation, math, public-knowledge lookups, or anything where the
user clearly is NOT asking about their own work history.

Primary tool: `omem query "<question>" --format json --limit 20`
Then progressively drill down via `omem page get <page_id>`,
`omem raw get <page_id> --parsed`, `omem raw get <page_id>`.
Usually one query and one page answers the question — read it, cite,
done. Only when a page's answer hinges on a specific term, person, or
document you haven't resolved, query again for that one thing — follow
the thread, don't crawl the graph.
Never call `omem setup / install / ingest / lint / index rebuild` —
those are user actions; tell the user in natural language instead.

translation, math, public-knowledge lookups, or anything where the
user clearly is NOT asking about their own work history.

Primary tool: `omem query "<question>" --format json --limit 20`
Then progressively drill down via `omem page get <page_id>`,
`omem raw get <page_id> --parsed`, `omem raw get <page_id>`.
Usually one query and one page answers the question — read it, cite,
done. Only when a page's answer hinges on a specific term, person, or
document you haven't resolved, query again for that one thing — follow
the thread, don't crawl the graph.
Never call `omem setup / install / ingest / lint / index rebuild` —
those are user actions; tell the user in natural language instead.
skills.name: omem

skills.description: 生成分层业务系统架构图与流程图，支持 PNG/SVG/HTML/PPTX 多种导出格式，内置中文字体自动检测与异常处理。
skills.description_zh:
产品架构图生成器（business-architecture-diagram）
一句话定位：把复杂的业务/技术分层结构，一键生成专业、可交付的分层架构图与流程图，支持 PNG / SVG / HTML / PPTX 多格式导出。

核心功能
分层架构图：自动排布「展示层 → 应用层 → 能力层 → 数据层 → 基础设施层」等多层结构，层名色块 + 圆角模块卡片。
连接关系：支持模块间箭头连线，标注依赖/数据流。
多格式导出：PNG（配图）、SVG（可二次编辑）、HTML（带悬停提示的交互版）、PPTX（演示版，缺环境时自动降级为 JS 模板）。
中文字体自适应：自动检测 Windows / macOS / Linux 中文字体，缺失时给出明确修复命令。
健壮校验：配置缺层、模块重名、连线指向不存在节点、画布超限等均抛 DiagramError 并附修复建议，不静默崩溃。
零模板起步：内置 DEMO_CONFIG，一行命令生成示例图。
适用场景
产品/技术架构汇报、立项材料、售前方案、培训课件配图。
需要将「文字版分层描述」转为「一眼看懂的架构图」的任何场合。
不适用：时序图、UML 类图、超大网络拓扑、3D 插画（超出本技能边界，会明确告知）。
主要价值
省时：从「画半天 Visio」到「填 JSON、跑命令、30 秒出图」。
可控：改配置即改图，版本化管理，避免手绘漂移。
可交付：输出物满足董事会/高管层汇报的视觉与专业性要求。
稳：边界输入有校验、有提示，不出现未定义行为。
skills.name: 产品架构图-business-architecture-diagram

skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to view, open, or share the "天津城市职业学院—一个人吃饭自习如何不尴尬Skill" (Tianjin City Vocational College Eating/Studying Alone Without Awkwardness Guide). It is a single-file interactive HTML page with a soft warm beige + milky-coffee low-saturation palette, a gentle peer-to-peer empathetic tone that reframes "eating alone / studying alone = no friends / unsociable" stigma, distinguishes loneliness from solitude, and reduces the anxiety of caring about others' eyes. The page includes 3 content sections (why solo actions trigger gaze awareness, cognitive reframe that passers-by barely notice you, positive examples of students using alone-time productively) and 3 interactive parts (opening single-choice "which gaze scares you most", mid-page pop-up "solitude anxiety self-test", ending 开放留言墙 about your first time eating alone). Trigger phrases include "打开独处攻略", "城职独处", "校园独处不尴尬", "一个人吃饭攻略", "独处焦虑测试", "打破独处刻板印象", and any request to preview or open the campus solitude guide HTML.
skills.description_zh:
本 Skill 为天津城市职业学院同学提供一份「一个人吃饭 / 自习不尴尬」的互动式校园指南，生成一张单文件 HTML（无需联网，离线双击即可开）。设计采用米白＋奶咖低饱和暖色调，整体氛围像朋友低声说话，温柔不劝诫。
内容三大主线：① 拆解尴尬来源——为什么一个人时总下意识去搜寻"别人的目光"、聚光灯效应与内心戏；② 认知重塑——路人其只顾自己、根本记不住你几分钟前的样子，区分"孤独"与"独处"；③ 正向案例——很多优秀学长学姐把独处时间用来高效学习和放松，独处是主动选择，不是被剩下。
三处互动环节：开场「你最怕被投来哪种目光」单选 → 共情回应；中段「你的独处焦虑程度」自测弹窗 → 温柔分级反馈；结尾「我第一次敢于一个人吃饭」开放留言墙，本地 localStorage 持久化、可随时回顾。不出现真实人物照片，无个人身份信息收集，不做临床诊断。
